column5: Mood: bright, warm, bustling — a sunny chibi army camp that is always busy *(inferred (strong))*
View: 3D (three.js, low-poly) · Camera: perspective tilted ~50°, turned 45°, follows with slight lag; on unlock glides to the new structure for 1.5 s and back
Shapes: chunky and round; big-head short-body characters; soldiers are one shared model; fish, bowls, plates, cash are simple stackable shapes

Palette: orange wooden deck (ground), blue river with moving highlights (water), green grass, round-post fences, pink blossom trees at edges; black-armored soldiers (zone 1), gold-armored (zone 2); yellow-gold for cash and glow. Warm light, cool blue-violet shadows *(guessed)*
Rules: flat cartoon shading, no outlines *(guessed)*, round blob shadow under characters
Signature: the back stack sways and leans with inertia on turns and grows past the top of the frame
References: the general look of arcade idle games — nothing copied. Every figure drawn, no emoji, no plain circles.
Movement with floating joystick and keys; camera follows with lag and glides on unlocks
Back stack: one item type at a time, capacity; items fly on and drop off one by one; sway and lean
Stations: 3 rods, chef's board + soup pot, fence counter, conveyor, grill (zone 2)
Endless soldier crowd; front row has logic with want-bubbles, steps back and refills
Price tiles (hire / upgrade / open-zone icons) that drain cash and count down, keeping partial payment
Workers: fishers (rod → board) and carrier/conveyor; workers never touch cash
Zone 1's six unlocks in the GDD's order and prices, then zone 2 (grill, sushi, gold soldiers)
Guide arrow to the next useful task for the first 3 minutes
Cash counter top corner; money rises from where it was made
Golden school: every 3–5 min, gold fish for 20 s selling at 5×
Save after every unlock (localStorage) + offline income capped at 2 h with a welcome-back popup
Feedback from the GDD's table: splash, rising-pitch clacks, puffs, bell, pop-up bounce (synth sound)

You stand on an orange deck by the river.
An arrow at your feet points to a white-outlined tile beside a bamboo rod.
You walk on; the rod bends and glows, and after 2 s a tuna arcs onto your back.
The arrow points to the chef's board; the fish hops off as you walk in.
The pot puffs and 4 bowls stack beside it.
Walk past: bowls hop onto your back with rising clacks.
Carry them to the fence counter: front-row soldiers grab them one by one, cash bursts and flies to you.
Around 60 s, after 5 fish, you stand on the first price tile ("100"): cash streams in, the number counts down, and a fisher pops up and starts working rod 1 — the first job you no longer do yourself.
No losing; the pressure is the moving bottleneck.
At first you are the bottleneck; after 3 fishers the kitchen is slow; after the second pot carrying is slow and the conveyor fixes it.
Each next unlock costs 60–90 s of income; prices rise ~1.5× per step and the gate costs 500.
Leaving a tile midway keeps what you paid.
Zone 2's sushi pays 3× but splits the fish between two dishes.
